fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: Fifteen days after Spring Festival, families walk on the bridge for the Lantern Festival. What does the moon usually look like that night?
questions.q_zh: 春节过后十五天，一家人到桥上过元宵节。那晚的月亮通常是什么样？
questions.explain_en: The 15th of a lunar month is near full moon.
questions.explain_zh: 农历十五前后是满月。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of New Year sweets on the bridge is 12 cm × 10 cm × 10 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一个年货礼盒长 12 厘米、宽 10 厘米、高 10 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora rides 1/2 km along Kunming Lake and then 1/4 km to the bridge. How many km does she ride? (simplest form)
questions.q_zh: Flora 沿昆明湖骑了 1/2 千米，又骑了 1/4 千米到桥上，一共骑了多少千米？（最简分数）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 60 visitors are on the Seventeen-Arch Bridge at sunset, and 15% of them carry lanterns. How many carry lanterns?
questions.q_zh: 傍晚十七孔桥上有 60 位游客，其中 15% 提着灯笼，有多少人提着灯笼？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 27, 32, 38 and 31 lantern boats floating near the bridge. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在桥边数到 27、32、38、31 只灯船，平均每晚几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A red carpet for the bridge's lantern show is 8 m long and 3 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯会铺的红地毯长 8 米、宽 3 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the bridge, 71 red lanterns and 56 gold lanterns are lit. How many more red lanterns than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 桥上亮着 71 个红灯笼和 56 个金灯笼，红灯笼比金灯笼多几个？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）
